reported.title: Blocking delay in acknowledge() stalls heartbeat and button scan
reported.description: acknowledge() uses delay(300), which blocks loop() so the 500 ms heartbeat drifts and the button is not scanned during the buzz; the heartbeat interval can exceed the ±120 ms tolerance and presses during the buzz are not properly ignored via state.

reported.title: Heartbeat timing drifts due to blocking buzz
reported.description: Because lastBeat is set to millis() after the blocking delay, the alive line period becomes 500 ms plus the 300 ms buzz, violating the 500 ms ±120 ms requirement whenever a press occurs.

reported.title: Buzzer pulse length not guaranteed 300 ms from press
reported.description: The 300 ms HIGH is produced by delay() inside the scan, so the pulse starts only after the 15 ms settle and blocks everything; combined with the blocking heartbeat this makes the pulse and timing unreliable relative to the 100 ms start requirement.

truth.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

truth_for_judge.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^alive \\d+$' every 500 ms (Heartbeat every 500 ms)

judge_input.spec:
- Call button on D5 with internal pull-up (active LOW); buzzer on D11.
- A settled press on D5 sounds the buzzer: D11 HIGH for 300 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 10 ms on press and release must not sound the buzzer twice.
- Presses while the buzzer is sounding are ignored.
- D11 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `alive <n>` every 500 ms ±120 ms, with n counting the lines printed.
